summary: 80 illustrative week-specific histories from the teacher-visible 30+50 examples. Explicitly corrected cases are A-. Ages reflect elapsed instructional weeks, not a quota. No student data.
representation: weekly_observations is a left-to-right character per elapsed instructional week; rightmost is latest. If multiple checks of one goal occur within a week, one holistic weekly summary requires review. Empty is not failure.
grade_authority: All working examples are calibration cases subject to task scope, independence, confidence and teacher approval; they do not authorize automatic grades or precise numeric cutoffs. Full A examples assume end-of-semester test corroboration and durability.
